description: Defines the interface for serial console operations, including functions for initializing the console, reading a character, testing for input, and writing a character.

methods.name: serial_console_getchar
methods.description: Reads a character from the serial console.

methods.name: serial_console_tstc
methods.description: Tests if there is a character available to read from the serial console.

methods.name: serial_console_putchar
methods.description: Outputs a character to the serial console.
